purpose: Evidence-oriented storage and retrieval of project decisions, insights, outcomes and records through MCP.

wire_contract.authority: Normative request/response fields, defaults, bounds and operation-specific errors.

tool_semantics.tool_register_project: Create a project namespace, or atomically update only domains and description for the same immutable name. request_id controls idempotency; rename is not supported.
tool_semantics.tool_log_decision: Append a decision with rationale, project, domain and authenticated actor attribution.
tool_semantics.tool_log_insight: Append a project-scoped insight with confidence and authenticated actor attribution; project is required.
tool_semantics.tool_log_outcome: Append an outcome with result, evidence references and authenticated actor attribution.
tool_semantics.tool_log_record: Append a typed public record with redacted content, references and authenticated actor attribution. This is an additive draft tool; Legacy had no MCP wrapper for its internal record function.
tool_semantics.tool_update_status: Apply a validated lifecycle status transition to a public core entry.
tool_semantics.tool_get_entry: Read one visible core entry and its public references.
tool_semantics.tool_get_context_for: Read bounded project context across decisions, insights, outcomes and records.
tool_semantics.tool_query_log: Filter public core entries by declared fields and bounded pagination.
tool_semantics.tool_query_log_fts5: Perform local SQLite FTS5 text search without embeddings or external model calls.

identity_authority.trusted_boundary: A configured CredentialProvider validates the raw transport credential and constructs the Principal before MCP dispatch. Forwarded headers, metadata and tool arguments are never trusted principal sources.
identity_authority.principal_validation: All fields required, canonical UTF-8 identifiers 1..128 characters, role in declared set, issuer and audience exact configured match, issued_at not in future beyond 30 seconds, expires_at after issued_at/current time, revocation_status exactly active. Missing, malformed, conflicting or provider-indeterminate claims deny before dispatch.
identity_authority.canonical_comparison: Unicode NFC then exact case-sensitive byte comparison; missing caller claim on tools that declare it returns IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
identity_authority.mismatch_order: Compare authenticated subject and asserted caller before object lookup, query, audit of object identifiers or mutation. Mismatch may write only a redacted security event without object existence.
identity_authority.rule: A caller_instance_id or actor field is a compatibility assertion only. It must exactly equal authenticated subject_id and never grants authority. Delegation is not supported in v1.
identity_authority.anonymous_policy: No listed MCP tool is anonymous; anonymous_allowlist is empty.

credential_lifecycle.provider_boundary: Issuance, protected storage, rotation, revocation, replay detection and compromise response are CredentialProvider responsibilities; the public core stores no raw credential.
credential_lifecycle.expiry_policy: Reject missing expiry, expired credentials and invalid/future issued_at before tool dispatch.
credential_lifecycle.revocation_policy: Reject revoked or indeterminate status; provider lookup/cache failure is deny. Revocation invalidates cache immediately or within a configured maximum 30-second TTL.
credential_lifecycle.replay_policy: CredentialProvider binds credential_id to audience and detects provider-defined replay; request_id independently deduplicates mutations.
credential_lifecycle.retention: Audit may retain credential_id hash only; never raw credential. Security-event retention is configuration with documented deletion.
credential_lifecycle.failure_policy: Return AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED without credential material, claim echo or fallback identity.

authorization_model.object_scope: All public-core objects belong to one configured tenant. Multi-tenancy and per-project delegation are out of scope for v1; enabling either requires a new contract and isolation tests.

privacy.coverage_rule: Every persisted or indexed string, string-list member and string-valued JSON leaf is potential_pii unless explicitly classified as a validated operational identifier or closed enum; recursively scan before DB, FTS, audit or log persistence.
privacy.write_policy: Scan every listed free-text field before persistence; replace email with [REDACTED:EMAIL] and other supported classes with stable [REDACTED:<CLASS>] markers. Reject malformed Unicode, unscannable input or policy violation.
privacy.read_policy: Return only persisted redacted content. No public tool can reveal pre-redaction values.
privacy.logging_policy: Do not log request bodies, raw free text, credentials or rejected values; audit stores field names and result codes only.

audit.failure_policy: A state-changing operation and its audit event commit in one SQLite transaction or neither commits. Audit insertion failure rolls back object mutation.
audit.append_protection: Canonical triggers operations_log_no_update and operations_log_no_delete abort mutations. Startup verifies table/columns and both trigger SQL digests; mismatch or absence sets read-only tamper mode and all writes return INTERNAL_ERROR.

errors.transport: stable machine-readable code, correlation_id and non-sensitive message
errors.existence_oracle_policy: v1 has no per-object read relation: allowed reader/writer/admin reads of absent IDs return NOT_FOUND; tool-level role denial occurs before object lookup and returns PERMISSION_DENIED without identifier/state detail.
errors.invalid_input_policy: Return field name and validation code only; never echo rejected value, query text or raw body.
errors.secret_policy: Never return credential, token hash, private path, SQL/schema/stack detail or pre-redaction value in any error.

idempotency_concurrency.mutation_key: request_id is required non-empty ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-], length 1..128; no Unicode or whitespace normalization; exact bytes plus subject and tool form identity
idempotency_concurrency.duplicate_same_payload: same canonical RFC8785-style JSON payload returns original result without second mutation/audit business event
idempotency_concurrency.write_control: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus state/version precondition inside transaction
idempotency_concurrency.retry: caller may retry only documented transient INTERNAL_ERROR/RATE_LIMITED with same request_id

compatibility.claimed_actor_migration: Existing caller_instance_id parameters may remain during one deprecation window but are assertion-only and mismatch-deny.
compatibility.breaking_change: Requires versioned contract, migration notes, compatibility tests and explicit owner decision.
compatibility.draft_2_change: Add tool_update_status.new_status to success response; required by frozen acceptance and lifecycle semantics; discovered by independent implementation review.
compatibility.identity_upgrade: Breaking pre-1.0 draft change: every public tool requires signed shared Identity Envelope; legacy caller claims remain non-authoritative assertions only.

stability.versioning: SemVer begins only after first accepted public contract
stability.deprecation: minimum one documented release or explicit pre-1.0 break decision
stability.immutability: released versions and artifacts are never silently replaced

statement_limits: This contract is not implementation evidence.
FTS5 support does not imply semantic/vector search.
Local synthetic tests do not prove production privacy, scale or outcome.

identity_envelope_contract.principal: principal_pubkey is sole request author and must equal verified request signer

owner_attestation.semantics: authorization evidence only; never rewrites author

profile_binding.spawn_rule: single fail-closed chokepoint; key+attestation+tenant+profile hash+runtime generation must resolve together

request_binding.tenant_rule: tenant_id must equal server-resolved tenant; never selects tenant
request_binding.signature_rule: Ed25519 over the domain-separated RFC8785 canonical envelope without signature; payload_sha256 binds the exact finite-JSON raw request after removing identity_envelope
request_binding.freshness: issued_at/expires_at required; bounded server clock skew

replay.order: verify signatures and bindings before atomic shared set-if-absent

revocation.effect: deny new request immediately; terminate or revalidate active session; invalidate caches; audit safely

compatibility_claims: caller_instance_id is assertion-only and cannot authorize
legacy bearer/provider credentials cannot bypass signed envelope
no registry fallback may authorize production OAuth/API-key credentials; the synthetic in-memory test adapter fails closed on ambiguous bindings and clears registry state after fork
